visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: An ArrayDeque Instead of a Global Array and Counter
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A static array and a static top index implement a stack, with string concatenation to build the output. Use an ArrayDeque as the stack and a StringBuilder. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: ArrayDeque grows by itself (the fixed array overflows after 100 pushes), and push and pop say what they do. The state also lives in a local variable instead of global fields.
